config.fpsdisplay.title: FPS Display Settings
config.fpsdisplay.show_fps_text.descript: Show the 'FPS' text before the numerical value
config.fpsdisplay.x_offset.description: Controls the X Offset from the left
config.fpsdisplay.y_offset.description: Controls the Y Offset from the top
config.fpsdisplay.hud_scale.description: The scale of the HUD elements, including the background
config.fpsdisplay.enable_frametime_graph: Shows a scrolling RTSS-style frametime bar graph below the FPS text
config.fpsdisplay.graph_width.descriptio: Width of the frametime graph in pixels
config.fpsdisplay.graph_height.descripti: Height of the frametime graph in pixels
config.fpsdisplay.graph_max_ms.descripti: Y-axis ceiling of the graph in milliseconds; bars reaching this height represent the worst frametimes
config.fpsdisplay.graph_color.descriptio: Bar color for frames under the yellow threshold
config.fpsdisplay.yellow_threshold_fps.d: Framerate threshold below which bars turn yellow (e.g., 60 FPS = 16.7 ms)
config.fpsdisplay.red_threshold_fps.desc: Framerate threshold below which bars turn red (e.g., 30 FPS = 33.3 ms)
config.fpsdisplay.yellow_color.descripti: Bar color for frames in the yellow range
config.fpsdisplay.red_color.description: Bar color for frames in the red range
